notes: Xiaomi consumer IP cameras (Mi Home / Mijia line) are primarily app-controlled (Mi Home app / Miloco). Xiaomi does not publish official RTSP URLs in any user manual, datasheet, or support KB on mi.com. RTSP access — where available — requires custom/community firmware (yi-hack, OpenIPC, kasitoru/mjsxj02hl_application) or unofficial P2P-to-RTSP proxy tools (Micam, docker-xiaomi-aqara-rtsp, go2rtc with Xiaomi source). The Home Assistant Xiaomi integration explicitly avoids RTSP because enabling the RTSP server on affected models disables the Mi Home app. No candidate lead path could be confirmed against an official Xiaomi source. All leads are excluded.
